status: development spike; not a production rollout candidate

method.scope: whole worker and existing API containers, 2 GiB limits, one executor per variant
method.measurement: host cgroup v2; working_set = memory.current - inactive_file; includes all processes and kernel charge
method.sampling: requested 100 ms; actual elapsed timestamps retained
method.startup: probe begins after health readiness; full startup peak is not measured
method.provider: local deterministic scheduler-fixtures; no paid/external model calls
method.cpu_comparison: Inconclusive for active work: Docker health confirmation lag made probe windows start at different workload phases. Counters are retained for audit, not used to assert a CPU improvement or regression. Request timings and final idle RAM remain directly observed.

registered_platform_job_live_coverage.agent.summary_backfill: parent reconciliation only; handler/backfill children not exercised

cold_start_method.definition: fresh containers and fresh Python processes; time from Docker State.StartedAt to application/readiness marker
cold_start_method.worker_readiness: host polls /proc/<host_pid>/root/tmp/bifrost-worker-ready; no instrumentation process enters the measured cgroup
cold_start_method.api_readiness: timestamp of uvicorn Application startup complete; API is ready before worker starts
cold_start_method.cache: image already local; filesystem/page cache, database and Redis warm; no requirements.txt packages to install
cold_start_method.not_measured: image pull, Kubernetes scheduling/CNI, real installed requirements, or production failover

cpu_comparison: Inconclusive for active work: Docker health confirmation lag made probe windows start at different workload phases. Counters are retained for audit, not used to assert a CPU improvement or regression. Request timings and final idle RAM remain directly observed.

catalogue_verification.scope: All 23 definitions, lazy imports, and policy materialization; not live handler coverage
